text: I am writing to let you know why I have missed the last three evening classes and to ask how I can catch up.

My company sent me to a trade fair in Frankfurt at very short notice, and I was away for almost two weeks. I was sorry not to be able to tell you in advance, but the trip was only confirmed the day before I left.

I understand from one of my classmates that you have started the unit on formal writing, and that there is a practice test next Tuesday. I would be very grateful if you could let me know which pages of the coursebook I should study, and whether there were any handouts that I could collect from you.
I would be happy to come in half an hour early before the next class if that would be convenient, or I could complete some extra exercises at home and hand them in for you to check.
Thank you for your understanding. I am looking forward to getting back to the course.

note.en: Adds how long the trip lasted.
Explains why there was no warning.
Adds a second piece of news from a classmate.
A polite condition: if it suits the teacher.

strengths.en: “If you could let me know which pages…” and “whether there were…” are polite ways to ask in writing.
strengths.kk: «if you could let me know which pages…», «whether there were…» — хатта осылай сыпайы сұрайды.
strengths.ru: «if you could let me know which pages…», «whether there were…» — так вежливо спрашивают в письме.
strengths.example: whether there were any handouts that I could collect

strengths.en: The student has already found out what was missed and offers solutions.
strengths.kk: Студент не жібергенін біліп алған және өзі шешім ұсынады.
strengths.ru: Студент уже узнал, что пропустил, и сам предлагает решения.
strengths.example: I could complete some extra exercises at home

strengths.en: No contractions, but warm: “Thank you for your understanding”, “looking forward to getting back”.
strengths.kk: Қысқартусыз, бірақ жылы: «Thank you for your understanding», «looking forward to getting back».
strengths.ru: Без сокращений, но тепло: «Thank you for your understanding», «looking forward to getting back».
strengths.example: I am looking forward to getting back to the course.

strengths.en: Each bullet point has its own paragraph.
strengths.example: My company sent me to a trade fair in Frankfurt

note.en: Two purposes in one sentence: to explain and to ask.
note.kk: Бір сөйлемде екі мақсат: түсіндіру және сұрау.
note.ru: Две цели в одной фразе: объяснить и спросить.

note.en: Bullet 1: the reason and an apology for not warning the teacher.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — причина и извинение за то, что не предупредил.

note.en: Bullet 2: what the student already knows and polite questions.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — что уже известно и вежливые вопросы.

note.en: Bullet 3: two ways to catch up.

note.kk: Алғыс және сабаққа қайта оралу ниеті.
note.ru: Благодарность и желание вернуться к занятиям.

note.en: “Kind regards” is polite but less formal than “Yours faithfully”.
note.kk: «Kind regards» — сыпайы, бірақ «Yours faithfully» сияқты ресми емес.
note.ru: «Kind regards» — вежливо, но не так официально, как «Yours faithfully».
